housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of GBP 628 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Aberdeen city centre; Rightmove provides current Aberdeen rental listings. A city-specific deposit norm was not established.

banking.summary: HSBC UK says current-account applicants need proof of identity and proof of address; non-UK nationals from outside the EU or Switzerland may also need a visa or residence permit.
required_docs: Proof of identity: passport, driver's licence, or EU identity card
Proof of address: utility bill, telephone bill, council tax bill, mortgage statement, or tenancy agreement
Visa or residence permit may be required for non-UK nationals from outside the EU or Switzerland

schools.summary: The International School Aberdeen offers the IB Diploma in Grades 11–12 and optional IGCSE qualifications in Grades 9–10; Aberdeen City Council publishes a directory of city schools.

legal_admin.summary: No universal Aberdeen-specific residence-registration step was established. Visa holders with an eVisa must ensure their UKVI account, immigration status, and passport details are correct before travel; requirements depend on immigration status.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a National Insurance number applies online and proves identity; a passport or qualifying European national identity card can be used, and an in-person appointment may be required if those documents are unavailable.

transport.summary: First Aberdeen's FirstMonth ticket provides unlimited travel for four weeks for GBP 95. Driving-licence exchange depends on the issuing country and individual circumstances. New residents staying more than three months register with a local GP practice by completing and submitting the registration form.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Use the official GOV.UK checker because exchange eligibility and the required process depend on the non-GB licence: https://www.gov.uk/exchange-nongb-driving-licence
transport.healthcare_registration: Find a local GP practice, contact it, complete the registration form, and submit it as instructed; permanent GP registration is for people staying in the area more than three months: https://www.nhsinform.scot/care-support-and-rights/nhs-services/doctors/registering-with-a-gp-practice/
